messages:
incident-bot: P1 page — Dedicated inference pool eu-west-1-high-gpu-01 reporting elevated 5xx error rate for customer BlueHarbor Finance (acct BHF-342). Error rate ~18% over last 3m. Paging @oncall (Ryan O'Connor).

Ryan O'Connor: on it, joining. quick q: is this affecting all BHF traffic or only specific model aliases?

Jordan Liu: I'm pulling logs now. looks like a subset of requests hitting gpu-07/gpu-09 are returning 500s. other nodes are OK.

Meera Singh: CS: we need a tailored comms pack for BlueHarbor ops + execs (contacts we have: eng-ops@blueharbor.com, ops-oncall +1-555-213-9876). They require: clear impact statement, ETA, and remediation steps.

Samir Patel: SLA concern? are requests failing persistently or intermittent?

Jordan Liu: preliminary: partial failures and elevated latency. fallback routing to a healthy cohort reduces errors but increases latency. no signs of data exfiltration.

Jordan Liu: Draft status page update (please review):
```
Redwood Inference — Partial degradation in EU dedicated inference pool (eu-west-1-high-gpu-01)
Impact: Select requests for customers on dedicated pools (including BlueHarbor Finance - BHF-342) may receive 5xx errors or elevated latency.
Mitigation: We have triggered autoscaling and are failing over affected nodes to a healthy cohort; engineers are actively replacing faulty GPU instances.
Current status: Investigating — mitigation in progress.
Customer guidance: If you experience failures, retry requests or switch to fallback model alias `redwood/fallback-v1`. We will post updates every 15 minutes.
Incident started: 2024-09-03 14:18 UTC
```

Meera Singh: Add an account-specific blurb for BlueHarbor and a short email + phone script. They expect an SMS/phone escalation for critical pages.

Jordan Liu: Draft customer-facing email for BlueHarbor:
```
Subject: Incident affecting inference for BlueHarbor Finance (BHF-342)

Hi <Name>,

We are currently investigating an incident impacting inference capacity in EU (eu-west-1). Some requests tied to your dedicated pool (BHF-342) may return errors or see higher latency. Our engineers have initiated autoscaling and are replacing affected nodes. Recommended temporary workarounds:
- Retry failed requests with exponential backoff
- Point requests to model alias `redwood/fallback-v1` for reduced errors
- If you have queued jobs, consider shifting to our hosted endpoint in a different region (contact support to enable)

We expect further updates within 15 minutes. For immediate assistance: eng-ops@blueharbor.com (we've routed a CS rep) and for critical paging call +1-555-213-9876.

We apologize for the disruption. — Redwood Inference Status Team
```

Jordan Liu: Phone/SMS script for CS to call BlueHarbor oncall: "Hi, this is Redwood Inference on behalf of BlueHarbor Finance — we're experiencing partial degradation on your dedicated inference pool. Engineers are replacing nodes now; please retry failed requests and contact eng-ops@blueharbor.com if failures persist."

Ryan O'Connor: Mitigation actions underway: cordoning gpu-07/gpu-09, spinning up replacements, switching BHF traffic to fallback cohort, temporarily relaxing KV cache for their pool to avoid stale state. Pushing config now.

Jordan Liu: Posted draft to the status page for review: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2419004321 (please sanity check wording).

statusbot: Status page draft posted: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2419004321 - state: Investigating (auto-update every 15m).

Meera Singh: Sending the tailored email to BlueHarbor ops and exec aliases now, and placing a hand-call to +1-555-213-9876. Will confirm receipt. :phone:

Samir Patel: any ETA on full recovery?

Jordan Liu: ETA ~30-45 mins depending on host replacements. I'll update if things converge sooner.

Ryan O'Connor: Quick handoff — I'm off in ~25m, Jordan will remain primary. @Samir please own the post-incident PM once this is stable.

Samir Patel: ack, will open postmortem and include comm timeline + customer messages.

statusbot: Incident state changed -> Mitigation in progress.

Jordan Liu: root cause notes: nvcuvid/driver I/O errors surfaced on gpu-07; taking host out of rotation and replacing.

Ryan O'Connor: Monitoring: error rate dropping from 18% -> 4% over the last 6m after failover. continuing to watch.

Meera Singh: BlueHarbor acknowledged receipt and asked for a short post-incident summary for ops/legal. Scheduling follow-up call at 14:45 UTC.

Jordan Liu: Final (near-term) update: errors stabilized, autoscale replaced 3 nodes, traffic back to healthy cohort. We'll transition status to Monitoring after 15m of <1% error rate.

statusbot: Status page updated -> https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2419004321 — state set to Monitoring (will confirm after stable window).

Samir Patel: Thanks everyone. Jordan/Ryan/Meera please drop any logs/artifacts into the incident ticket and tag me. I'll own the timeline and customer comms in the postmortem. :white_check_mark:

Jordan Liu: Copy, uploading logs to ticket now.

Ryan O'Connor: Leaving watch but reachable if needed.

Meera Singh: CS will draft the tailored post-incident summary and share with BlueHarbor legal + ops.

incident-bot: Incident closed for paging? (follow-up to be tracked in ticket INC-2419004321)

Jordan Liu: closing thread here, continuing monitoring in ticket. thanks all. :slightly_smiling_face:
